name: World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Changed hands by interference on the promotion's own first served pay-per-view and was carried by its new holder through the promotion's next served card.

name: United States Championship
epitaph: Crowned vacant on the promotion's own first served pay-per-view, then held into the promotion's next served card despite a count-out loss.

name: Television Championship
epitaph: Changed hands twice across the promotion's own three served cards.

name: Apex Championship
epitaph: The promotion's own namesake title, defended and lost within its earliest served weeks before changing hands again by interference in a three-way.

name: Hard Knocks Championship
epitaph: Renamed live from the Iron Man Championship by the promotion's incoming owner minutes after its first served title change.
